column1: # API prices in US$ per million tokens, for the month's cost in the header's
# agent column (header_tokens.sh costs). Plans are not billed per token, so
# the cost is what the same tokens would cost on the API: an indication.
# Columns, tab-separated: model, input, cache write (5 min), cache write (1 h),
# cache read, output. A model is matched exactly, else by the longest listed
# prefix (a dated id); one not listed is left out and the cost is marked "+".
# Claude: Claude API pricing, cached 2026-09-25 (cache writes 1.25x / 2x the
# input price). OpenAI: published rates, October 2026 (no cache-write charge,
# so writes cost the input price).
